notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Palinchron.
When Palinchron and Archaeomancer enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Displace to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
